hookups.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails: all 86 Foxhill sites 'Site Type: Electric', 'Electricity Hookup: 20/30/50'; all 27 Sandpiper and 10 North View sites 'Electric', '30'; no water or sewer hookup listed on any. Read 2026-10-28

values.note: Foxhill 86 electric sites (20/30/50 amp; vehicle lengths 20-60 ft, mostly 40; 42 pull-through), Sandpiper 27 (30 amp; 20-40 ft; 12 pull-through), North View 10 (30 amp; 40 ft; 9 pull-through). 15 sites list a 20-ft maximum vehicle length (Foxhill 153, 154, 200, 202, 204, 212, 214; Sandpiper 117, 119, 133, 135-137, 139, 141). CPW marks Sandpiper 128, 130 and 132 'Lakefront'.

sites.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails for all 123 sites in the three loops (Site Type, Electricity Hookup, Maximum Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, Proximity to Water), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Shower houses and flush toilets close for the off season, reopening the first weekend of April; vault toilets then.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/jackson-lake-state-park/jackson-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('a camper services building with showers, drinking water and toilets'; 'Amenities include: ... Showers, Electrical hook-ups, Dump station, Water'; 'Shower houses and flush toilets will remain closed until the first weekend of April. Vault toilets are available.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead of arrival. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass (kiosk near the entrance station). No transfers to another site after arrival.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/jackson-lake-state-park/jackson-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Jackson Lake State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance of your arrival date'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period') + cpwshop site pages ('Max Reservation window: Wed Apr 28 2027'; 'RESTRICTION: Upon arrival at your reserved site, there will be NO TRANSFERS to another site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Every site in the three loops is an electric site at $36 a night (January, a June Saturday and July alike). Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass ($10-$15) or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails with arrival dates 01/12/2027, 06/19/2027 and 07/14/2027 for Foxhill 150, North View 232 and Sandpiper 128 ('Camping Fees (1 Night) $36.00 /Per Night') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/jackson-lake-state-park/jackson-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Single campsite (max 6 occupants) 1 Night $28 - $36'; 'Daily Vehicle Pass: $10-$15'), read 2026-10-28

note: Contiguous chain of three loops on the reservoir's northwest side: Sandpiper's east row (128-132) sits at the edge of the wide sandy beach apron; Foxhill and North View are set back from the shore to the north. Reservoir draws down for irrigation by mid/late summer. --Claude
summary: CPW pages + every cpwshop site page for the three loops: changed sites 124 -> 123 (Foxhill 86, Sandpiper 27, North View 10), electric 30 -> 50 (Foxhill 20/30/50; the other two 30), fees $28-36 -> $36 (all three loops are electric; the $28 basic sites are elsewhere). Added max rig 60, pull-through, showers/flush/vault/water, deep link, 6-month window, 14-night max, fcfs never. Note corrected: Foxhill is NOT a no-hookup loop.
flags: Note error fixed: the stored note called Fox Hills 'the no-hookup loop'; cpwshop lists all 86 Foxhill sites as Electric 20/30/50 amp and prices them at $36.

Season conflict, left unset: the CPW camping page says 'During the off season (October through March), the following campgrounds remain open: Lakeside, Cove and Pelican' - implying these three loops close Oct-March - but every cpwshop page for Foxhill, Sandpiper and North View says 'Status: Open year round.' and Foxhill 150 offered 'Book Now' at $36 for Jan 12, 2027. Ask CPW or leave unknown.

Waterfront: stored lakefront is supported by the operator's per-site attribute - cpwshop tags Sandpiper 128, 130 and 132 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (none in Foxhill or North View). On Esri imagery 128/130/132 sit on the east row at the vegetation edge, with the open sand beach apron immediately east (no berm or tree belt between); the waterline itself is out of frame at drawdown. The other 120 sites are set back.
Pin 40.3949,-104.0969 is ~180 m west of the Sandpiper site centroid (40.39478,-104.09479) and ~340 m from Foxhill's (40.39762,-104.09506); North View's is 40.40091,-104.09524. Fine.
Phone 970-645-2551 confirmed on the CPW park page (park contact).
Open now; the only park alert is the seasonal shower-house/flush-toilet closure until the first weekend of April.
